# exoscale_ai_api_key (Resource)

Manage Exoscale [AI API Keys](https://community.exoscale.com/product/concrete-ai/dedicated-inference/overview/), used to call AI deployments and public models.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "exoscale_ai_model" "my_ai_model" {
  zone = "at-vie-2"
  name = "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B"
}

resource "exoscale_ai_deployment" "my_ai_deployment" {
  zone      = "at-vie-2"
  name      = "my-ai-deployment"
  model_id  = exoscale_ai_model.my_ai_model.id
  gpu_type  = "gpu3080ti"
  gpu_count = 1
  replicas  = 1
}

# API key granted access to a single deployment
resource "exoscale_ai_api_key" "my_ai_api_key" {
  zone = "at-vie-2"
  name = "my-ai-api-key"

  deployment_ids = [
    exoscale_ai_deployment.my_ai_deployment.id,
  ]
}

# API key granted access to all the public models
resource "exoscale_ai_api_key" "my_public_models_api_key" {
  zone       = "at-vie-2"
  name       = "my-public-models-api-key"
  all_models = true
}
```

Please refer to the [examples](https://github.com/exoscale/terraform-provider-exoscale/tree/master/examples/)
directory for complete configuration examples.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) ❗ The AI API key name (`1`-`50` characters).
- `zone` (String) ❗ The Exoscale [Zone](https://www.exoscale.com/datacenters/) name.

### Optional

- `all_deployments` (Boolean) Grant access to all the deployments of the organization. Takes precedence over `deployment_ids`, which is ignored when set (default: `false`).
- `all_models` (Boolean) Grant access to all the public models. Takes precedence over `models`, which is ignored when set (default: `false`).
- `deployment_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the [`exoscale_ai_deployment`](./ai_deployment.md) the key has access to. Unset denies access to all deployments.
- `models` (Set of String) The names of the public models the key has access to. Unset denies access to all public models.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The AI API key creation date.
- `id` (String) The AI API key ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The AI API key secret. It is only returned at creation: it stays null after an import.
- `updated_at` (String) The AI API key last update date.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

-> The symbol ❗ in an attribute indicates that modifying it, will force the creation of a new resource.

## Import

```shell
# An existing AI API key may be imported by `<ID>@<zone>`
# (the secret is only returned at creation and won't be imported):

terraform import \
  exoscale_ai_api_key.my_ai_api_key \
  f81d4fae-7dec-11d0-a765-00a0c91e6bf6@at-vie-2
```
